entities.name: Wang et al . [171]
entities.description: A multi-stage retrieval method that uses a non-parametric retriever to extract n-hop paths and then retrieves one-hop neighbors of entities in a pruned subgraph.

entities.name: OpenCSR
entities.description: A two-stage retrieval method that first retrieves 1-hop neighbors of a topic entity and then selects top-k nodes based on similarity.

entities.name: GNN-RAG
entities.description: A method that employs GNNs to retrieve top-k answer nodes and subsequently retrieves shortest paths between query and answer entities.

entities.name: Multi-stage retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval strategy where different stages employ various types of retrievers tailored to different aspects of the query.

entities.name: Iterative retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval paradigm that involves higher time complexity but can yield higher accuracy by iteratively refining retrieved information.

entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A general framework for graph-based retrieval-augmented generation, discussed in the context of retrieval complexity and response times.

relationships.description: Wang et al. [171] utilizes a multi-stage retrieval process involving non-parametric retrieval and pruning.
OpenCSR divides the retrieval process into two distinct stages.
GNN-RAG employs a sequential process of GNN retrieval followed by path retrieval.
